text: Though always polite, it was his habit to receive such services with marital coolness, as his wife’s duty. But to-day, while she was bending over him, he said, “You are very good, Harriet,” in a tone which had something new in it to her ear; she did not know exactly what the novelty was, but her woman’s solicitude shaped itself into a darting thought that he might be going to have an illness. “Has anything worried you?” she said. “Did that man come to you at the Bank?” “Yes; it was as I had supposed. He is a man who at one time might have done better.
